name: DP-based Configuration Selector
aliases: DP-based Configuration Selector — Multiple-Choice Knapsack Configuration Selection
definition: A configuration selection module that finds the optimal configuration pair for each segmented object's NeRF to maximize total rendering quality within a fixed memory constraint, formulated as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack (MCK) problem.
summary: The DP-based Configuration Selector optimizes NeRF configurations for multiple objects under memory constraints by solving a Multiple-Choice Knapsack problem via dynamic programming to guarantee optimal quality.
